text.p: Shurgard Storage Centers Inc said Friday it has completed its offers to purchase units in three limited partnerships.
Owners of limited partnership units in IDS/Shurgard Income Growth Partners LP tendered 62,913 units, or 42 percent of the total. Shurgard had offered a net cash price of $257 per unit.
Owners of IDS/Shurgard Income Growth Partners LP 11 tendered 36,303 units, or 32 percent of the total outstanding. Shurgard had offered a net cash price of $222 per unit.
Finally, owners of partnership units in IDS/Shurgard Income Growth Partners LP III tendered 49,718 units, or 42 percent of the total. Shurgard had offered a net cash price of $308 per unit.

In July, Shurgard agreed to buy the three limited parternerships. Shareholders still must vote on a merger of the limited partnerships into Shurgard. A vote is expected to to be held in November, Shurgard said in a statement.
